metadata.title: Rank-One Sutured Instanton Homology Detects Homology Products
metadata.abstract: We prove that a balanced sutured manifold $(M,\gamma)$ satisfying $\dim_{\mathbb C} SHI(M,\gamma)=1$ is an integral homology product; that is, $H_*(M,R_-(\gamma);\mathbb Z)=H_*(M,R_+(\gamma);\mathbb Z)=0$. Consequently, for every taut balanced sutured manifold $(M,\gamma)$, $SHI(M,\gamma)\cong\mathbb C$ if and only if $(M,\gamma)$ is a product sutured manifold. The proof uses the enhanced Euler characteristic of $SHI$ and a specialization formula for sutured torsion.
